title: Keep Bot Work Running Past Usage Limits
summary: Route heavy background jobs to coding agents you already pay for and keep a daily record of what ran, so your bot team does not stall halfway through the week.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes you run several bots and already pay for a coding agent plan; the value is work that does not stall.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Work keeps moving instead of waiting for your usage to reset.
who_its_for: Founders who run several bots on one account.
Small teams that already pay for Claude Code or Codex.
